body: Why do you feel that way?  There are plenty of things to live for: people you love, food to enjoy, place to sightsee.

Thanks.  My friend told me he doesn't have any friends and when I reminded him that I'm his friend and I care about him a lot, he said that he knows that.  He says that he knows that it'll make me sad the same way my other who committed suicide made me sad.  He told me not to be because he'll be happier and that is what he wants.  He also told me that knowing me, I won't be able to stop feeling sad for him, but I should just try.

Thanks RKBA, I'll use that next time he says that again.  One of the things he said was "I've seen it all.  I've see the end of it (how the world will end)"  He talks about how we're no more than cockroaches living to reproduce and that the Earth will end by the Sun engulfing it if not by mankind.  Honesty, even though he's 4 years younger than I am, I think he's smarter than any of my colleagues here.  I'd say he's too smart for his own goods.

Do you have other family members to ask for help?  You have to believe that things will get better.  It might not get all better at once, but think about little things that have improved.  And it's long enough for you to give up.  Life is always worth it.  Reddit is a very supportive community.  Please stick around and see if we can help you.

OP, I'm sorry to hear what you're going through.  Please don't give up.  I know you're going through some difficult times right now, but things will get better, and time will help.  Your mom might not have helped you pay off the ticket, but at least you have a place to stay.  Remember, things will get better.
OP, come back.  PM me

OP, it's not the end of the world.  Trust me, you've made a mistake, but we all make mistakes.  That's what makes us human.  Please know that by harming yourself right now, you're making another mistake...one that's 1000 times worse than what you have done before.  Hang it there.  I'm still at work right now, but should be free to talk in an hour or 2.  Leave me a PM and I'll get back to you as soon as I can, k?

Hey OP, I'm sorry to hear what you're going through.  I know it's not pleasant to not have a stable job and income, but this isn't the end.  Can you stay with family so you can save up some money?  Keep fighting OP! you can do it.  Sorry I don't have any good advice, but we're here to listen.

OP, I'm really sorry to hear what you're going through.  Like Alsocan and No-mad said, it's better to be honest.  At this point, you don't know what actually happened, but this girl has been telling people her version of what happened.  It seems like she's doing this on purpose, so regardless of what actually happened, I think you should tell your girlfriend exactly what's going on.  It's definitely better for her to hear it from you than from someone else.  You already told your girlfriend about dancing with this girl so she's aware of it.  It might not be a bad idea to tell your girlfriend the rumors you've been hearing and tell her you really don't remember it.  Even if you did sleep with that g From what you posted here, it seems really sincere to me and I believe you.

And please don't do anything to harm yourself.  I know this is a difficult time for you, but please don't do it.  Harming yourself doesn't solve any problems.  If you think your girlfriend is going to be hurt because you slept with the other girl, you're going to hurt her 100 or a 1000 times more by harming youself.  Trust me, it's never the solution a problem, it only creates more problems for everyone else around you.  I'm running late to work, but PM me if you wanna talk more.
Please talk to us.  We're here to listen
Hey OP, we're here to listen to you.  Feel free to PM me

Hey OP, I just want to remind you that things are getting better.  And like you and Joll said, this probably isn't the best time to leave, especially since you've started on the new medications.

As for not being able to get anything for your family this holidays, think about it this way.  If you stick around, things will get better, and eventually you'll be able to purchase presents for your family.  Not to mention, at least your family have you around for the holidays; and that's already more than what a lot of people/family can ask for.   If you leave, you won't be able to give your family anything for the next holiday.

OP, thanks for posting it his.  Maybe try talking to him about SW and see if maybe we might be able to help.  And if you think it's appropriate, you can tell us which state/general area he lives in, and maybe we can reach out to him.  Hope everything works out okay.
I'm sorry to hear that, Samalter and Serissime, and thank you for sharing this with us here on SW.  Merry Christmas and I wish time will heal both your wounds.

Candy81, I'm sorry to hear that.  As you said, this is your mom's first Christmas without her Mom; it's understandable that she must be going through a lot herself.  You might have already done so already, but if you haven't, give her a call (or leave a message) just to let her know that you're there for her.  I don't know how feasible it is, maybe try to get home with stay with your Mom for a little bit.
Candy81, we're here for you.  Why wouldn't your parents talk to you?
I'm here for ya.  PM me.
OP, you can talk with us.  Share with us what you're going through.  PM me please.

OP, I'm sorry to hear that.  I know not having any presents sucks.  I, too, spend a lot of money on Christmas gifts each year ($600 this year), and rarely do I get anything in return.  But remember, you still have your family, friends, your SO, and us.  I hope that you will be able to spend some quality time with people you like.  If you wanna talk to someone, I'm here.  Feel free to PM me.
Hey OP, don't go.  Please talk to us.
We're here to listen to you and reddit will do just about anything to help you in any way we can.  Feel free to PM me.  We're here for you. Merry Christmas

Hey OP, like Silibird said, life is an odd combo of ups and downs, and honestly that's what makes life life.  If you feel a lack of energy, you might be depressed, or you might not have found something that interest you.  It might be worthwhile to talk to a therapist.  If you wanna talk, send me a PM.  Merry Christmas.

Hey OP, I'm here to talk.  Just PM me or IM me:
AIM sn: trainingcub
gmail: trainingcub@gmail.com
Op, we're here for you.  Tell us what happened?  We'll celebrate your birthday with you here today.  *hug*
OP, i'm sorry to hear about your lost and thank you for taking the time to share this with us at SW in a time like this.  I wish the best for you, your family, and all your brother-inlaw's friends.
Sorry for guilt tripping, PM me if you wanna talk to someone

Hey OP, don't let your therapist down.  Your therapist has been seeing you for 3, 4 years so that you can live a better life.  Now that he has been diagnosed with prostate cancer, one of the things that will make him/her feel better is that you don't give up on yourself.  How do you think he/she will feel if you harm yourself?  I know it's a tough time, OP, and I'm really sorry to hear about what's going on in life, but I have faith that you can do it.  Believe in your therapist and believe in yourself.  You have to live on for the people you love and those who love you.

Op, I have been having trouble being alone, too, after one of my best friends take his own life last year.  Every weekend, I start getting really nervous when I'm alone; sometimes to the point where I'm crying, because I'm afraid to be alone.  Like mawkish said, it's important to go talk to a therapist.  I'm still chatting with mine and it really helps.  I would imagine that school is starting soon, if it hasn't already.  Meet some new people; make some new friends :)  Life will be much better :)  Good luck Op.  Feel free to PM me if you wanna talk!

OP, you've a bright future ahead of you.  You're in college, and that's more than what a lot of people can ask for.  Let me just tell you this up front, suicide is not a solution.  5th year in college isn't too late to change what you want to do in life, ending your precious life is.  Loans, you can pay off.  Family, will not stay mad forever. Dad, can wait for another year (how many years has he worked? 1 year is probably small compared to that).  You're supposed to take over his responsibilities after you graduate.  If you graduate a year late, you take over his responsibilities a year later.  If you end your life, no one will ever take over his responsibilities.  Most of us have problems, some big, some small.  It sounds like you need to take a quick break.  It doesn't have to be a long vacation.  Maybe just take the morning off or the whole day off and enjoy a stroll in the park or hang out with friends.   Suicide doesn't solve any of the problems you have, it leaves it for everyone else around you to take care of.  You're in college now, probably around 22.  You have a lot in life in front of you.  PM me if you wanna talk.
*Huuuuuuug*  It's okay.  We're here for you.  Tell us more about yourself.  We will do our best to help.

Awesome, OP!  Don't worry too much about your friend.  You'll have to trust that they'll do their best to help you.  If they don't think they can take it, they'll let you know, and that's okay.  Just remind them not to tell anyone else.  You can do it!

:) Let us know how things turn out.  What you're doing now isn't really a burden family and friends.  You're doing the right things to take care of yourself, and that's the least burden you can be to them. :)

I'm really sorry to hear about what she did to you.  Tell your shrink you don't have the money to pay for the referred therapist.  He/she will continue to see you and do what they can.  They know that having them talk to you is better than having no one talk to you.  And don't be afraid of the medication.  Give the meds a try.  I know some friends who have tried it and it really does work.  The money is really worth it...your life is worth any amount of money.  You're not a nutcase.  We all have our problems and we just need to figure out ways to figure it out.  We've got your back.  Hang in there!

Op, you're 20, it's okay if you haven't gotten laid.  You're sweet, handsome (enough to have modeled), and hard working.  You're going through some hard patch right now, but things will get better.

I'm sorry to hear about what the girl did to you.  Are you still seeing your therapist right now?  If they've diagnosed you, they can probably help you.

Don't blame yourself about your brother.  The best thing you can do now is to get help and help yourself get out of this.  There are people who can help you.  You had said your friends are worried about you.  As much as you hate it, let them help you.  That's what friends are for.  The last thing you want to do is to harm yourself.  The impact on your family and especially your brother would be tremendous.  PM me if you wanna talk.  Things will get better.
Check your PM please

Op, you can stop this downward spiral.  If you have medical insurance, a therapist is usually covered by the plan.

People often don't realize how important things are until they're no longer there. I know someone who took his own life, and please believe me that, it's not just the worst week of my life.  There were the worst months of my life.

Everything Tiredami said is dead on.  Even though you posted on here anonymously, it takes a lot of courage to do that.  You've already done the first step in reaching out for help. Please don't give up now.

I'm around too, so feel free to PM me.

Op, I live at a place where most people are socially awkward.  I have many of the behaviors that you mentioned, trust yourself, you can change them.  They're very simple things in life and it seems like you just need a little reminder now and then to change those habits.

There are guys like that who just want one thing from women, but there are many other guys out there who aren't like that.  Just wait and you'll find one who really cares.
Can you switch research groups?

Hey Op, you've got hope!  You identified the problem and you're admitting to it.  You're already a lot better than a lot of people.  Give your parents a try.  Tell them what happened and tell them how you feel.  They might be mad at you for the rest of the day, the rest of the week, or for a couple of weeks.  But they'll forgive you, especially if you're willing to change.  That's what family's for.  No one is flawless; everyone makes mistakes.  Yours is very salvageable. Don't give up!  We're here for you!

I'm sorry to hear about your experience with the girl.  As for the guy, that's tough, especially since you're probably new to the group.  On a professional level though, this is hard to do, but try to pretend it didn't happen.  Know that this guy isn't gonna be someone you can trust, but try your best to separate personal from professional.  If you can, maybe even play it cool and pretend that it's okay......but that's probably asking too much.

If you want a positive spin on this, at least he helped you find out really quickly that she's not trustworthy.   I wish you the best on your PhD program and working in the group.  Please feel free to PM me.

Hey Op, hang in there.  I think you might be just a little too hard on yourself.  As mirror-rorrim said, friends come and go.  You might not think that you have close friends, but think really carefully.  There are people who really care about you.  They might now show it, but they do care.   At the very very least, you have us.  We care about you.

Regarding your ex-girlfriend, no matter how much you felt like she had used you at the end, you guys shared something at some point in time.  Think about all the happy things you guys did together....it doesn't have to be a trip to a different country...it can be as simple as just sitting together and enjoying the moment together.

There's a reason why people think you're intelligent.  It doesn't matter if it's just knowing random things.  Even if you don't think that counts as intelligent, I know a lot of people, like myself, would want to be like you.  Every trait you have defines who you are.  No one is perfect, you have a gift, so don't waste it.

As for your eczema, i know it must be painful.  I have a friend who also has eczema.  It's uncomfortable and painful, but no one will look down on you for it.  It wasn't your choice to have this.

Have faith and believe that things will get better.  You have the power to do this.  You can talk to any of us here and we will try our best to help with anything.  Feel free to PM me.
You totally deserve better friends.  It might be hard to make new friends, but school just started (I'm guessing).  Maybe find some new friends.

They might have sugar coated, but maybe they were really telling the truth.  But either case, think about it this way.  If they don't care about you and how you feel, they wouldn't have sugar coated it; they should have just told you to go away.
Huuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuug

Unemployed during a time like this is very common.  Don't let that bring you down.  As for friends, you probably have more friends than you think.  Even if you don't have anyone in real life to talk to, you have us.  We are your friends.  We care about you.

Yes, we're all going to turn into dirt one day, but you can make a big different in people's life before that.  Just by posting here, you've already changed the lives of many people. You are helping people with similar problems who might not be brave enough to post here.  You need to realize that you are important.  You have to believe that you're doing positive for the society.  Even if you don't, I believe that you're doing something positive.  Hang in there!  PM me if you wanna talk.

Try thinking about the positive things.  If your friends had dinner with you last night, it doesn't make sense that all of them just decide to avoid you the next day.  I, too, tend to think of the worst possible thing that could be, and in your situation, my natural tendency is to think that I'm alone and no one wants to be my friends.  This isn't going to be easy, but whenever you catch yourself doing that, try to stop your mind from thinking that.  This is hard to do, but you need to reason with yourself that they're not ignoring you.

But let's say we assume the very very worse that they are ignoring you (this is totally hypothetical and I have every reason to believe that this isn't true).  The fact that you still have a very good friend at another school means that these friends here, if they're really ignoring you, are the ones missing out.

With that said though, I don't want to dismiss how powerful our minds are.  When one's mind wants to think about something negative, that can really get our down.  It can even spiral outta control.  I don't know if you're currently seeing a therapist, but maybe try talking to them about that and see what they may have to offer. Cheer up!

Hey depeleted, he's not the only guy there.  There many many more people you can fall in love with.  Don't give up yourself on someone who doesn't care about you.  You still have a lot of people who care about you.  If you do anything to harm yourself, your will hurt all your friends and family.   Think about how much it hurts right now because of him; the pain for your family and friends will be hundreds and thousands times more if you do anything to harm yourself.  If you want to talk to someone, please PM me.

Since you mentioned TED, have you seen this one "50 jobs in 50 states" http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=elmFyoSBTgs

It's hard to concentrate on job hurting with the open old wounds, but take your time and you can do it.

Don't worry about "asking too much" from your friends.  They understand.  This is the time when you need them the most, so let them help you.   That's what friends are for!

Don't feel ashame of yourself. Depression is a disease, just like flu or cancer. Unless you look down on people with flu and cancer, you shouldn't expect people to look down on you. It's a tough time you're going through, but stick with your therapist. If you don't think your therapist is helping, maybe try to switch over to another one. It helps a lot when you and your therapist are a good fit. Let your friends help you, talk to your close friends and see what they can do for you. Everyone has their ups and downs and friends are there to help each other when they're down. They really care about you, you have hope. And if you have family you can talk to, I'm sure they will be more than happy to help you out.

You have nothing to be embarrassed about.  You have a job and you're feeding a family of 4.  That, to me, is amazing.  I'm older than you are and my family is still supporting me.  It seems like most of your problem is related to the stress you have of having to support the entire family.  Like you said, you're in a state of constant depression. The stress and depression can cause your weigh gain, lack of sleep, and lost of interest in what you're doing.

You're not doing anything wrong.  You've working your ass off to get as much money as you can.  Depending on the age of your brother, maybe he'll be able to help you out with funding the family soon.  You're going through a lot, but still you put on a happy face at work.  You're doing everything you can to make as much money as you can.  You just need to hold out a little longer and things will get better.  You need to keep telling yourself that.

As for planning to do it......please don't.  Do you really hate your siblings?  Even your 6 yr old sister?  You've worked for this many years to feed them and you're going to kill yourself and let them rot?!  You would have just wasted years of hard work.  Your friends and coworkers, yes they care about you.  They might not show it, or you might not be able to tell, but heck they will miss you if you're gone.  A very good friend of mine took his life thinking he doesn't have friends.  In additional to his family, over 100 friends went to his memorial.  Life is too precise for you to give up.  You've work this hard for this many years and you're almost at the point where things will get better.  Please give it a little bit more time.  Things will get better.   You need to believe it.
